title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 20
paragraphs: This much I know from the account of the Delphians; but the Milesians add that Periander the son of Cypselus, who was a close guest-friend of Thrasybulus, at that time tyrant of Miletus, heard of the oracle that had been given to Alyattes and sent a messenger to tell Thrasybulus, so that he might know in advance and take whatever counsel the situation required. This is the Milesian version of the story.
